name: officedex
description: The AI desktop workspace for documents, slides, and spreadsheets. Wails v2 + React 19 client for OfficeCLI.

scripts.build: wails build -ldflags "-X main.appVersion=$(node -p 'require(`./package.json`).version')" && npm run bundle:officecli:mac
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prefetch:officecli && wails build -ldflags "-X main.appVersion=$(node -p 'require(`./package.json`).version')" && node scripts/bundle-runtime.mjs && npm run bundle:officecli:mac && node scripts/notarize.mjs build/bin/OfficeDex.app
scripts.dist:win: npm run prefetch:officecli && wails build -platform windows/amd64 -ldflags "-X main.appVersion=$(node -p 'require(`./package.json`).version')"
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npx vitest run && go test ./... -count=1 && npm run test:e2e
